Kai Tran: FYI — customer 'Aurelia Health' on private deploy hit a decrypt failure after our recent KMS key rotation. App-side errors: 403 from keystore-proxy and 'unauthorized decrypt' in logs. :eyes:
Maya Singh: ugh. timeline? did the rotation go through CRON or manual?
Kai Tran: automated rotation on their private control plane at 04:10 UTC. First error spike at 04:13.
Devon Parker: can you paste the exact error lines from keystore-proxy? might be RBAC or mTLS issue between proxy and HSM shim.
Kai Tran: sure — logs below (sanitized):
```
2026-02-10T04:13:21Z keystore-proxy[main] ERROR tenant=aurelia svc=keystore-proxy msg="decrypt failed" code=403 reason="policy: decrypt not allowed for key:kms-arn/abc123"
2026-02-10T04:13:22Z keystore-proxy[main] WARN  svc=keystore-proxy upstream="hsm-connector" status=403 token_id=svcacct-aurelia-01
```
Maya Singh: looks like the KMS policy didn't grant the service account permission to use the newly created key version. Did the key alias flip-over fully propagate to the HSM?
sec-bot: Detected: IAM_BINDING_CHANGE for service-account svcacct-aurelia-01 at 2026-02-10T04:09:58Z. Reference: audit-id:e7f3.
Devon Parker: @sec-bot can you dump the effective KMS policy + RBAC mapping for that tenant? Also check the keystore-proxy's service token (long-lived?) vs ephemeral certs.
sec-bot: Effective policy snapshot: `roles/keystore-user` -> allows: [Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey], bound to principal svcacct-aurelia-01. Note: new key version requires explicit principal list update; rotation job updated alias but skipped principal propagation due to a race (known issue #INF-412).
Ops Eng: Confirmed — rotation job has optional flag `--propagate-principal`. It defaulted to false in 2.1.0. Customer is on 2.1.0.
Kai Tran: ah — so alias points at new key but principals not authorized yet. That explains 403. What's the mitigation path without full rollback?
Maya Singh: short-term: add svcacct-aurelia-01 to the new key's principal list manually. Longer-term: patch rotation job to set propagate flag by default and add a pre-rotate check that asserts principal parity.
Devon Parker: agree. Also need to ensure network policies didn't block the keystore-proxy from reaching KMS endpoint during the brief window. Any netpol events?
Kai Tran: netpol logs show no denies — connectivity OK between proxy and hsm-connector. The error is authorization.
Maya Singh: action item: add principal -> verify decrypt -> remove risky elevated perms. Do we have an audit log trail to show when the alias swap happened for the customer's compliance team?
sec-bot: Audit entry created: `rotation-job` executed by automation-runner@infra at 2026-02-10T04:10:05Z. Alias swap and key creation events present. Principal propagation attempt flag recorded as false.
Ops Eng: I'll run the manual principal add now and post verification steps.
Ops Eng: (runs) `kmsctl grant --key abc123 --principal svcacct-aurelia-01 --actions decrypt,generateDataKey` — confirmed exit 0.
Ops Eng: verification: app-side requests now returning 200 and logs show successful decrypt latency ~12ms.
Kai Tran: thanks. Customer reported restored. I'll open a postmortem doc and link audit artifacts. We should also notify the on-prem support runbook team.
Maya Singh: for postmortem include: root cause (rotation job default flag), immediate remediation (manual grant), mitigation (rotate job fix + add preflight + monitor), and compliance artifact (audit trail).
Devon Parker: additional security ask: ensure keystore-proxy enforces token scoping so service accounts can't escalate to arbitrary keys during flare-ups. Also add an alert when decrypt 403 rate > 5/min.
Kai Tran: noted. I'll create a GH issue for INF-412 patch and INF-413 alerting.
Maya Singh: quick network policy checklist while we're here: 1) verify egress to HSM endpoint locked to known FQDNs/IPs; 2) keystore-proxy pods must have deny-by-default ingress; 3) audit egress via flow logs for 24h after remediation.
Ops Eng: running netflow capture now and will upload to the privacy bucket (access-limited).
sec-bot: Reminder: for private deployments we require KMS principal propagation tests in the preflight checklist. Adding test case to infra-agent suite.
Kai Tran: communication to customer: "We're sorry for the disruption. Root cause: key rotation propagation flag didn't propagate principal permissions. We've manually applied a fix and are rolling a patch to automation to prevent recurrence. Audit trail attached." Anyone want to tweak that wording?
Maya Singh: sounds good. Add ETA for patch: 48 hours for hotfix, 2 weeks for full rollout with upgrade notes.
Devon Parker: I'll pair with infra to validate the keystore-proxy's behavior with ephemeral certs to reduce reliance on long-lived service tokens.
Kai Tran: great. Closing the loop: I'll post the postmortem link and set follow-up meeting in #eng-security. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
